title: P-auth2: canBan may add a non-member as banned
description: room-policy-04 §8.1: canBan says 'another user', canChangeUserRole says 'another participant'. Appendix A.1 policy_enforcer's (from 0, [1]) role-change entry only makes sense if a non-member can be added directly as banned. Chosen: AddParticipant{target 1} is authorized by canBan (with is_banned_role, mimid-1wgh.3.42).
